contexts.text: They who are atheists and naturalists, as they are called, are those who are learned.
They are relegated among those who are called naturalists.
They ascribe all things to nature... and become naturalists, and at last atheists.
In proportion as they confirm themselves from fallacies they become naturalists...
He feared being called a naturalist...
Such are all naturalist atheists in the world, and all satans in Hell.
At this day... there are many naturalists...
They deny the creation... by God, and thus God, for they are naturalist atheists. The reason all these are evil, is...
Say to a confirmed naturalist, who believes either that nature has created herself, or that God came forth after nature, or that nature and God are one...
Who speaks more persuasively about the certitude of his own phantasy than a naturalist atheist...
At first Wolff was a naturalist...
A natural religion adapted to the apprehension of all naturalists.
(The dragonists) are chiefly naturalists, and in their hearts deny the Divine...
Most (of these Spirits) were naturalists...
Concerning naturalists in the other life. - Very many of them think... If there is a God, etc., I can easily believe these things if I see them in the other life... But this is impossible. Explained.
They who have lived evilly... reject religion, and become naturalists.
Concerning naturalists.
There is a like light after confirmations with those who are called naturalists, who deny God and the Divine of the Word, and, besides, all things of the Church.
Every man who has become a naturalist by thoughts from nature remains such after death, and calls all the things natural which he sees in the Spiritual World...
A naturalist atheist can swear that there is no God...
